crossRefs.note: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul…
But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

translations.web: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.
translations.bsb: Like cutting off one’s own feet or drinking violence is the sending of a message by the hand of a fool.
translations.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
translations.asv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off his own feet, and drinketh in damage.
